about: The reviewed Anthropic model row of the preview spending gate (PR B). The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py, AnthropicProfile) and the app (packages/providers/src/preview-models.ts) must both equal this file; a price change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. Prices are Anthropic's list prices in USD per million tokens (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-10-10). The row's input/output prices are the lower step's (0.10 / 0.50): the app ESTIMATES at them, and an uncached call RESERVES at them when its request bytes + overhead_bytes are at most the lower step's 100000 tokens (its prompt cannot reach the upper step). Above that, the call reserves at the upper step's input and output prices (reservation.upper_*: 0.50 / 2.50) (owner ruling 2026-10-10, evening). Prompt caching (owner approval 2026-10-12): a request whose system is exactly two text blocks, the first carrying cache_control {"type": "ephemeral"}, reserves its whole input at its step's 5-minute cache-write price instead (row cache_write_5m_input_usd_per_m 0.125 at the lower step, 0.625 at the upper; the app's start-of-debate estimate keeps the row's plain input price and sees the cached worst case through the gate's in-flight hold), so the worst case (262144 bytes, cached) is (264192 x 0.625 + 32768 x 2.50) / 1e6 = 0.247040 (reservation.ceiling_*), and an uncached one 0.214016. Any reply's cache tokens are settled at their own prices (never a halt by themselves); a reply costing more than its hold is charged and halts the gate with charge_overrun. Settlement uses the real step (settlement_steps): the prompt total (input + cache creation + cache read tokens) above 100000 tokens uses the upper step; a cache write without its 5-minute/1-hour split is the 5-minute kind on a cached call and the 1-hour kind on any other. effort high means the request carries output_config {"effort": "high"}.

reservation.formula: ((request utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes) * input price + output_bound * output price) / 1000000
reservation.step_rule: request bytes + overhead_bytes <= step_tokens: the row's prices (cached: the lower step's cache-write input price); above: the upper step's (cached: its cache-write input price, the ceiling)
reservation.cache_write_rule: a request whose system is the two-block form (cache_control {"type": "ephemeral"} on the first block) reserves its input at its step's cache_write_5m_usd_per_m (settlement_steps) instead of the step's input price; output unchanged
